g.text: Active: sessions can be started on this project · on
Allow sessions to access connected email accounts · off
Allows interactive sessions in this project to access the operator's connected mailboxes. Off by default.
This project's own prompt wording is edited under Prompts on the web dashboard; saving here keeps it as it is.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

The settings sidebar is the app's own, not the preset: ← Back to sessions, This computer (🎙 Meeting assistant), Mail, Projects, Providers, Database pool, SSH servers, Forge accounts and MCP servers, each with ＋ New where allowed,
then a footer with 'Settings' and ⎋ Sign out. It has no Devices and clients row.

Project dots: filled (idle) means active, a grey dot means switched off. A 'db' chip marks a project with the database pool on. ↑ and ↓ show on the open or hovered row, and right-clicking a row gives Move up / Move down.

The header shows the label in large type with the repo under it. Save (Ctrl+S) has an icon and the label 'Save'; ⧉ clone and 🗑 delete are icon-only buttons. A new project shows only Save, under the subtitle 'A project is a
repository a session can be started against.'
A tab with unsaved changes gets a ' •' after its title. The open tab stays open when you switch to another project. A field the server's project rows do not carry is hidden.
With the Active box cleared, a note appears: 'Inactive: no session can be started on it and it is left out of the project lists; …'.
Without an Admin token, the Projects section shows a sentence explaining the token is needed instead of the rows.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
